templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum covering the use of AI services within a product, including input and output ownership, restrictions on use, and related warranties and disclaimers.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
templates.description: HIPAA business associate agreement setting out a provider's obligations, permitted uses and disclosures of protected health information, safeguards, and breach notification duties.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
templates.description: Standard terms for providing a cloud service or SaaS product, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, IP, warranties, indemnification, and liability.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
templates.description: Data protection terms governing processor and subprocessor relationships, security measures, data subject requests, and international transfers of personal data.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early design partners receiving pre-release product access in exchange for feedback, covering access terms, feedback rights, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Mutual NDA - Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of a mutual non-disclosure agreement, covering the definition and permitted use of confidential information, exclusions, and return or destruction obligations.

templates.name: Mutual NDA - Cover Page
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the Mutual NDA that captures the parties, purpose, term, and governing law, and incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement between two companies collaborating on a partnership, covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark use, confidentiality, and term and termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a time-limited paid or unpaid product pilot, covering pilot access and use, evaluation purposes, fees, and conversion to a full agreement.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
templates.description: Master terms for professional services delivered under statements of work, covering service delivery, personnel, deliverables and ownership, fees, and expenses.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
templates.description: Service level terms for a cloud service, covering target uptime, uptime calculation and exclusions, support response times, and service credits.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Terms for licensing on-premise or downloadable software, covering the license grant and restrictions, delivery, support, fees, IP, warranties, and liability.
